status: dens: one lair for each of the Mega field's 23 dens (data/gulch_mine.json farms), generated by `python tools/mega_field.py dress` from the seven hand-authored kits in superseded_dens (2026-10-04: the field packed to its floor; before it, 11 dens of 2026-10-03). The seven are superseded_dens with the farms they dressed (docs/world-building/MEGA_FIELD.md). Was: authored 2026-10-02; built by tools/mega_dens.py into cobblers_mega_dens, run by the re-application's step R9MD (after R9S, before R9E). NOT yet flown: docs/world-building/MEGA_DENS.md 'World probes' are what a session holding the server checks
owner: The owner, 2026-10-02: "Den dressing rather than a taller trigger box. I want to see something from the air and go down to it, not trigger a spawn by flying near. That is the whole 'seen, not reached' idea."
source: The dens themselves -- species, anchor, leash, the farm and its tier -- are data/gulch_mine.json farms[].dens[], read here by `den` and never copied: this file owns only the DRESSING round each anchor. A den's Mega is spawned AT its anchor by the gulch's keeper (cobblers_gulch_mine), which this pack does not touch.
lighting_why: Wild lairs, dark by design: no lantern, torch, campfire or any light-emitting block (crying obsidian, magma and froglights included). 'Places are lit as towns' is for places people keep; nobody keeps these. A dark lair also means the dressing's snow and packed ice are never melted by block light.

anchor_pad.why: The keeper spawns the Mega AT the anchor. Every column within clear_radius (horizontal distance <= 3) is levelled to the anchor's own ground (anchor y - 1) with the den's `pad` block, and the head_room blocks over it (anchor y .. anchor y + 5) are written AIR, which also clears any skin debris lump the Rift pass left there. Nothing else is written within 3 of the anchor. 6 is gulch_mine.json megas.slots[excadrill].head_room, the precedent for a big Mega; Steelix's 10 is for a serpent and none of these is one. The pad is one block at ground level and its columns never differ from the anchor's ground by more than one (measured: pinsir has one column a block higher, cut to air; garchomp one a block lower, under the pad).

layout.why: Roughly 24-30 blocks across, readable from the air: a scraped disc (scrape_radius with a ragged edge) of churned ground in colours the Rift skin's distortion stone and tuff do not have, a broken ring of shoved boulders just outside it with a gap where the trampled approach comes in, a carcass of bone, and the species' own sign at `feature_at`. Nothing that stands on the ground comes within object_clear of the anchor, so the Mega's spawn pad is open on every side. max_rise is the tallest thing over its own ground (an ice spire, 6, with one for a stacked log).

approach_why: The trampled approach runs from the scrape's edge toward the nearest point of the critical path (data/route_paths.json), measured 2026-10-02 and committed as `approach_toward`, so the track a player finds on the ground points the way they came. It is a mark, not a route: a den stays off the critical path (the nearest is 191 blocks, abomasnow).
feature_why: `feature_at` is the den's sign, set feature_r blocks from the anchor on the side AWAY from the approach, so a player coming up the track sees the lair, then the Mega, then the sign behind it. Committed rather than derived so the audit reads it from here and not from the builder.
dig_why: Only two dens go below their ground: tyranitar's crater and garchomp's burrow. `dig` bounds it: below-ground writes only in columns within `radius` (horizontal distance) of feature_at, and never deeper than `depth` under the ground at feature_at itself (round(ground), tools/ground.py). Everywhere else a den writes its own ground surface and what stands on it, and the anchor pad's one levelling block.
bounds_why: write_box [x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1] is the anchor +/- data/gulch_mine.json mega_field.layout.lair_radius (21 since 2026-10-04; it was 27, when the seven hand records were written) horizontally and anchor ground - 8 .. + 14 vertically: every block a den writes is inside it (the generator refuses otherwise and the audit checks the written function). 21 because the Mega field packs its dens as close as two lairs allow (the owner, 2026-10-04: Megas 'pressing against each other for space'): the lairs' measured reach was 14 to 23, the 23 the approach track, which layout.approach_to now ends at 20 (it was 24). Each box is inside data/gulch_mine.json farms_grid.
zones_note: Two anchors (abomasnow, tyranitar) are INSIDE the Rift zone z2's area (data/rift_zones.json zones.z2.boxes) and aggron's box reaches it: the gulch placed them there, and a zone's area is an access region the whole upper terrace sits in, not a footprint of blocks. What rift_zones builds are its cross-walls (cuts) and gatehouses (posts); the audit keeps every den 32 or more blocks from those, and from the gulch's own block box (gulch_mine.json grid) and zone polygon, the towns' footprints, every placement and every resident anchor.

substitutions.minecraft:sand: minecraft:smooth_sandstone and minecraft:sandstone -- sand is a spawn condition (data/spawn_blocks.json) and no policy entry allows it here; Garchomp's burrow is sandstone, which reads as sand from the air
substitutions.minecraft:magma_block: minecraft:coal_block and minecraft:blackstone -- magma is a spawn condition, and a light source
substitutions.minecraft:iron_block: minecraft:raw_iron_block -- iron_block is a spawn condition
substitutions.minecraft:iron_ore: minecraft:raw_iron_block and minecraft:raw_copper_block -- iron ore is a spawn condition
substitutions.minecraft:ice: minecraft:packed_ice and minecraft:blue_ice -- ice broken by a player leaves WATER, a spawn condition for 84 species; packed and blue ice never melt or leave water

blocks.rule: No chest, no bed, no light source (lighting: dark). None of these is a spawn condition in data/spawn_blocks.json; the audit checks that against the file, not this list.

superseded_dens_reason: Superseded 2026-10-03 with the seven dens they dress (data/gulch_mine.json superseded_farms; docs/world-building/MEGA_FIELD.md). The owner: 'everywhere in the red inside the rift should be the mega area, not just spawn one randomly in the world.' None of the seven anchors is in the Mega field or in the Rift basin at all. Kept, not deleted: each record's sign, feature, approach and write box are hand judgement no generator re-derives, R9MD applied them to staging on 2026-10-02 (so these write boxes say where a lair stands there), and dressing the field's dens is a separate owner call (MEGA_FIELD.md section 4). With no den, tools/mega_dens.py writes an empty pack and R9MD has no steps.
